scope: Local Werewolf-only strength search after B0; not a deployment or tournament-strength claim

decision.why: Positive mean on all six observed development seeds; additional commitment/bluff/position rules were not reliable improvements. Known background regression retained.

experiments.name: own_public_commitment
experiments.result: All three variants had zero observed win changes; the small diagnosis found no eligible pivotal override.

experiments.name: proactive_wolf_claim
experiments.result: Unconditional claim lost; ally-target gating had zero development mean and +0.232pp replication mean with conservative interval crossing zero; not combined.

experiments.name: night_priority
experiments.result: Tie-high positive; always-high noisy; preserving daytime target very small gain. Claimed-seer priority and other-role behavior preserved.

experiments.name: strict_extreme_reduction
experiments.result: Requiring fewer exposed extreme wolf seats removed almost all gains; balanced/extremes0pp then+0.054/+0.161pp; tie-high control remained positive.

experiments.name: endpoint_nonincrease_guard
experiments.result: Shielded+0.143/+0.321pp, below tie-high+0.179/+0.661pp, still had losses; not selected.
